title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Rider: Daily Facility Charge and Monthly Program Fee
content:
PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) bills by the day. Every calendar day carries the tier's daily facility charge; the first day of each calendar month also carries the monthly program fee; and the energy used is priced at the block 1 energy rate of the underlying service account's own rate schedule, which applies to every kWh.

| Tier | Daily facility charge (USD per day) | Monthly program fee (USD, first day of each month) | Energy price source |
|---|---|---|---|
| PrePay Power Residential | 1.07 | 5.00 | block 1 energy rate of the underlying rate schedule |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 25 | 1.07 | 5.00 | block 1 energy rate of the underlying rate schedule |
| PrePay Power Residential Recovery 40 | 1.07 | 5.00 | block 1 energy rate of the underlying rate schedule |
| PrePay Power Seasonal | 1.27 | 5.00 | block 1 energy rate of the underlying rate schedule |
| PrePay Power Outbuilding | 1.38 | 5.00 | block 1 energy rate of the underlying rate schedule |
| PrePay Power Small Commercial | 1.38 | 7.50 | block 1 energy rate of the underlying rate schedule |

Notes:
- The energy price is not set by this rider; it is the block 1 energy rate published for the underlying rate schedule.
- Hypothetical illustration: over a thirty-day month a PrePay Power Outbuilding account carries thirty daily facility charges of 1.38, totalling 41.40, and one program fee of 5.00 on the first day of the month.
